body: This custom modpack enhances your Minecraft experience with a variety of client-side features designed to improve gameplay. It includes a mini-map for easy navigation, performance tweaks for smoother gameplay, and more. With these additions, players can enjoy a more efficient, visually appealing, and immersive Minecraft world. Perfect for those looking to streamline their experience while exploring, crafting, and building!
